purpose: Teach: マツダ/尾根/漆/覆面/胡椒/縞/大理石/洗車

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお父さん、マツダ車乗ってんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — your dad drives a Mazda, doesn't he?
lines.style: Bright, casual probe. Leans in slightly. Testing whether he'll admit to knowing she knows. Playful rhythm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族で山の尾根を歩いたろ?桜
lines.en: You hiked a mountain ridge with your family, didn't you? Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet comeback. Measured pace. Slight smile in the voice — returning serve. Not aggressive, just even.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、漆塗り体験したろ?
lines.en: Riku — you did that lacquer-painting workshop, right?
lines.style: Pressing forward, building momentum. Quick rhythm. Eyes bright. Testing how much he's noticed about her noticing him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭で覆面被ってたろ?桜
lines.en: You wore a mask at the school festival, didn't you? Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle mirror-back. Not mocking. Slower, softer landing than her last volley. Noticing that she was trying not to be noticed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ペッパーランチで胡椒たっぷりかけたな
lines.en: Riku — you loaded up on pepper at Pepper Lunch, didn't you.
lines.style: Dry delivery, slight edge of affection. Not quite a question. She's caught him in something small and ordinary and is treasuring it anyway.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、縞模様の制服似合うよな、桜
lines.en: You look good in that striped uniform, Sakura.
lines.style: Direct compliment. Brief exhale before he says it — small courage moment. Steady eye-contact level. No backpedal.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、大理石の床の家、憧れだろ?
lines.en: Riku — you dream about living in a house with marble floors, don't you.
lines.style: Softer now. She's holding something he's revealed. Gentle observation, not teasing. Slow, warm delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お父さんと洗車手伝ったろ?桜
lines.en: You helped your dad wash the car, didn't you? Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet, intimate. Close as a whisper across the space between them. She's given him something; he's returning it whole. Small, genuine.
